title: What If You Fell Through a Tunnel Through the Earth?

scenes.text: What if you fell through the Earth? You'd come out the other side.
The tunnel would be about eight thousand miles long. Gravity would pull you faster the whole way down.
At the center, you'd hit roughly seventeen thousand miles an hour. You'd feel weightless there.
Then gravity would slow you down, and you'd just reach the far surface. About forty minutes after jumping.
In a perfectly even Earth it's forty-two minutes. With real rock density, closer to thirty-eight.
The catch: air resistance. The tunnel would need to be a vacuum, or you'd float stuck at the center.

description:
What if you fell through a tunnel straight through the Earth?
About forty minutes, a top speed near 17,000 miles an hour, and a vacuum tube you'd need first.
What should we run through next?
